summary: Internal-only frontend for simulated ticket triage review, similar-ticket assistance, and live support dashboarding using only authoritative API endpoints.

pages.purpose: Provide a simple internal landing page to start the POV workflows: create a simulated ticket for review, open a known ticket by ID, or navigate to the live dashboard.

data_requirements.name: support teams reference
data_requirements.needed_for: Optional contextual summary or route to create/review forms that may display known teams.

api_consumption.usage: Optional prefetch for display of available support teams and reference data.

user_actions.action: Enter an existing ticket ID and open review

loading_states: Optional teams prefetch skeleton if showing reference content.

error_states.ui_response: Show non-blocking warning; landing actions remain usable.

pages.purpose: Allow an internal user to create a simulated POV ticket record that can then be reviewed for stored triage suggestions and similar resolved tickets.

data_requirements.name: active support teams
data_requirements.needed_for: Populate optional assigned team selector if the simulated ticket should be created with an assigned_team_id.

api_consumption.usage: Populate optional assigned team dropdown and team labels.

user_actions.result: Prepare POST body with required ticket fields and optional manual_priority/channel/assigned_team_id/resolution/triage_suggestion.

user_actions.action: After successful create, continue to ticket review

loading_states: Form submission in-progress state with submit button disabled.

error_states.ui_response: Keep form usable; hide or disable optional assigned team selection and show non-blocking warning.
Show field-level and form-level validation messages based on API contract constraints.
Show duplicate ticket ID error and let user edit ticket_id.
Show retryable error banner; preserve entered values.

pages.purpose: Support simulated agent review of a ticket by showing the ticket details, any stored triage suggestion, and 3-4 similar resolved historical tickets with resolutions.

data_requirements.name: ticket details
data_requirements.needed_for: Display the current simulated or imported ticket context.

data_requirements.name: stored triage suggestion and suggested team
data_requirements.needed_for: Show suggested priority and routing recommendation.

data_requirements.name: similar resolved tickets
data_requirements.needed_for: Show 3-4 semantically similar resolved tickets and resolution details.

data_requirements.name: active support teams
data_requirements.needed_for: Fallback team-name mapping or supporting context if needed elsewhere on page.

api_consumption.usage: Load ticket metadata and body text for the review screen.
Load stored suggested priority and suggested team.
Load 3-4 similar resolved tickets for agent assistance.
Optional reference prefetch only; primary triage API already returns suggested_team details.

user_actions.action: Open ticket review by URL or navigation after create
user_actions.result: Load ticket detail, triage suggestion, and similar tickets in parallel where possible.

user_actions.action: Toggle number of similar tickets between 3 and 4
user_actions.result: Refetch similar tickets with limit=3 or limit=4.

loading_states: Initial page skeleton while ticket details load.
Independent card-level loading placeholders for triage suggestion and similar tickets.
Refetch spinner when switching similar-ticket limit.

error_states.ui_response: Show not-found empty state and actions to create a new simulated ticket or go home.

error_states.case: GET triage suggestion returns 404 because ticket not found
error_states.ui_response: Treat as page-level not-found if ticket details also missing; otherwise show section error if inconsistent.

error_states.case: GET triage suggestion succeeds with triage_suggestion=null and suggested_team=null
error_states.ui_response: Show neutral empty state: no stored triage suggestion is available yet. Do not imply the frontend can generate one because no such API exists.
Show explicit empty/error state that similar-ticket retrieval is unavailable because the ticket lacks text_embedding; do not offer generation because no embedding API exists.
Treat as page-level not-found if ticket details missing; otherwise show section error if inconsistent.
Ignore silently or show low-priority warning; page remains functional from ticket and triage APIs.

error_states.case: Unexpected partial failure in triage or similar sections
error_states.ui_response: Keep other sections visible and offer section-level retry.

pages.purpose: Provide live operational visibility into support performance with ticket volume by product line, ticket volume by priority, and average resolution time by team using the authoritative dashboard APIs.

data_requirements.name: active support teams
data_requirements.needed_for: Optional reference list or filter labels if desired, but not required because avg-resolution response already includes team_name.

api_consumption.usage: Load average resolution metric; note raw returns team aggregates over range, snapshot can return time-bucketed points.

user_actions.result: Refetch all dashboard queries with selected startDate and endDate.
Refetch product-line and priority charts; for avg-resolution endpoint include granularity only when using snapshot mode.

user_actions.action: Switch source between raw and snapshot
user_actions.result: Refetch all metric endpoints with chosen source. UI must require granularity for avg-resolution-time when source=snapshot.
Refetch all three metrics on demand.

loading_states: Filter-change refetch indicators that preserve prior chart content when possible.

error_states.ui_response: Show filter validation message and prevent or correct invalid date submission.
Show filter validation or card error. For avg-resolution-time snapshot mode, require granularity before request.

error_states.case: One metric fails while others succeed
error_states.ui_response: Display partial dashboard with per-card error and retry.

error_states.case: No points returned for a valid range
error_states.ui_response: Show no-data state for that chart, not an error.

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: Global navigation and internal-only layout wrapper linking Home, Create Ticket, and Dashboard.

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: Standardized page title and contextual actions.

components.name: OpenTicketByIdForm
components.purpose: Minimal form to navigate to a known ticket review route because no list/queue endpoint exists.

components.name: SimulatedTicketForm
components.purpose: Form for POST /api/tickets using only fields allowed by the API contract.

components.name: TeamSelect
components.purpose: Dropdown backed by GET /api/teams for optional assigned_team_id selection.

components.name: OptionalTriageSuggestionFields
components.purpose: Optional advanced fields allowing seeded triage_suggestion values at ticket creation because the API stores but does not generate them.

components.name: TicketSummaryCard
components.purpose: Display current ticket metadata and status.

components.name: TicketTextPanel
components.purpose: Display ticket subject and description prominently for agent review.

components.name: TriageSuggestionCard
components.purpose: Show stored suggested priority, model metadata, confidence, and suggested team details.

components.name: SimilarTicketsPanel
components.purpose: Container for similar resolved ticket results and limit toggle.

components.name: SimilarTicketCard
components.purpose: Render each historical similar ticket including resolution category, summary, assigned team, and similarity score.

components.name: DashboardFilterBar
components.purpose: Shared controls for date range, granularity, source mode, and refresh.

components.name: MetricCard
components.purpose: Reusable dashboard section container with loading, error, and no-data variants.

components.name: TimeSeriesChart
components.purpose: Visualization for product-line and priority time-series points.

components.name: TeamPerformanceChartOrTable
components.purpose: Visualization for average resolution time by team; handles both raw aggregate and snapshot time-bucketed response shapes.

components.name: NotFoundState
components.purpose: Page-level empty state for missing ticket IDs.

components.name: SectionEmptyState
components.purpose: Section-level explanation when data is validly absent, such as no stored triage suggestion.

constraints_and_non_goals: Do not design or imply a queue/queue-list page because no authoritative queue endpoint exists.
Do not design controls to generate triage suggestions or embeddings; the API only retrieves stored suggestions and similar tickets when embeddings already exist.
Do not design mark-resolved or workflow completion actions because no such endpoint exists.
Ticket review is by direct navigation or after create; there is no API for browsing tickets.
Similar-ticket assistance depends on text_embedding already existing on the ticket record; frontend must expose this limitation clearly.
Dashboard avg-resolution-time visualization must respect API asymmetry: raw mode is aggregate by team over range, snapshot mode may be time-bucketed.
